mission: Make operator-facing next commands copy-safe, location-safe, non-destructive, and terminal-preserving.

repository_location: Never assume a remembered machine-local path or user profile name.
When the current repository root is not proven in the current shell, use an isolated checkout under an environment-derived root such as LOCALAPPDATA or TEMP.
Verify canonical origin before treating an existing checkout as this repository.
copy_safety: PowerShell intended for direct paste must not contain Markdown hyperlink syntax.
Avoid raw auto-linkable URLs in chat-delivered PowerShell when a repository slug or split string can express the same target.
Do not use a top-level exit statement in an interactive PowerShell command envelope.
remote_pin: Verify the intended remote branch resolves to the exact expected 40-character commit before checkout or validation.
Use detached checkout or an isolated worktree/clone for unmerged proof.
preservation: Refuse dirty proof checkouts instead of resetting, cleaning, stashing, or overwriting them.
Never discard a separately owned primary checkout merely to run validation.
artifact_resolution: Resolve the canonical artifact by artifact ID through harness/artifacts.v1.json.
Print or open the resolved artifact only after the owning validator succeeds.
failure_behavior: Set ErrorActionPreference to Stop for PowerShell proof scripts.
Convert nonzero native process results into terminating errors without closing the operator terminal.

proof_ceiling: Static command-shape, fixture, repository integration, and executed validation proof. It does not prove the operator machine has network access, GitHub authentication, Python, or the target runtime.
